title: नेपाली व्याकरण शिक्षण गर्दा अपनाइएका कार्यकलापहरूको अध्ययन {Study of The Activities Adopted While Teaching Nepali Grammar}
nepali: प्रस्तुत आलेख व्याकरण शिक्षण गर्दा अपनाइएका कार्यकलापहरूको अध्ययनमा केन्द्रित छ । अध्ययनलाई पूर्णता प्रदान गर्न कक्षा ६ को पाठ्यक्रमले निर्देश गरेका व्याकरणका क्षेत्रलाई आधार बनाई सम्बन्धित शिक्षकहरूबाट तथ्य सङ्कलन र विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । यसरी अध्ययनलाई अगाडि बढाउन सामग्री सङ्कलनका विधिको रूपमा क्षेत्रीय अध्ययन विधि उपयोग गरिएको छ भने सामग्री विश्लेषण विधिको रूपमा वर्णनात्मक एवं विश्लेषणात्मक विधि अवलम्बन गरिएको छ । अध्ययन समग्रतामा व्याकरण शिक्षण गर्दा अधिकांश शिक्षकहरूले निगमनात्मक पद्धतिकेन्द्रित कार्यकलापहरूको प्रयोग गरेको तथ्यबाट पुष्टि हुन्छ । कतिपय कार्यकलापहरू विद्यार्थीको शैक्षणिक तथा मनोवैज्ञानिक स्तरभन्दा कठिन रहेका छन् । कक्षा अवलोकन र प्रश्न प्रतिक्रियाका आधारमा यी कठिन कार्यकलाप सञ्चालन गर्न शिक्षक प्रयत्नशील भएपनि परिणाम अपेक्षाअनुसार नआउने देखिन्छ । व्याकरणको आधारभूत अवधारणा शिक्षण गर्नुपर्ने कक्षा ६ का विद्यार्थीहरूलाई स्तरअनुसार थप कार्यकलापमा आवृत्त गराउन भाषा पाठ्यपुस्तक विधि तथा भाषा संसर्ग विधिअनुरूप समुचित कार्यकलापहरू प्रयोग प्रयत्न आवश्यक छ । यद्यपि व्याकरणको क्षेत्रगत वैशिष्ट्यता अध्ययन गरी आगमनात्मक पद्धतिअनुसार कार्यकलाप निर्धारण र प्रयोग अभ्यास गर्नु गराउनु आवश्यक रहेको छ । वस्तुतः शिक्षकहरूमा व्याकरण शिक्षणप्रति रहेको रूचि र तत्परताले उचित कार्यकलाप व्यवस्थापन तथा प्रशासन गर्न सक्षम रहेका छन् ।
american_english: The present article focuses on the study of activities adopted while teaching Nepali grammar. To bring the study to completion, facts were collected and analysed from the relevant teachers, based on the areas of grammar prescribed by the class 6 curriculum. Thus, to advance the study, the field study method was used as the method of data collection, while the descriptive and analytical method was adopted as the method of data analysis. The study is confirmed overall by the fact that most teachers used deduction-centred activities while teaching grammar. Certain activities were more difficult than the students' academic and psychological level. Even though teachers tried to conduct these difficult activities based on classroom observation and question response, the results did not come out as expected. To teach the basic concepts of grammar to class 6 students, it is necessary to attempt the use of appropriate activities in accordance with the language textbook method and language contact method, making students repeat activities according to their level. Although it was necessary to determine and practice activities according to the inductive method by studying the areal specificity of grammar. In fact, teachers were capable of managing and administering appropriate activities due to their interest and readiness towards grammar teaching.

australian_english: The present article is centred on the study of activities adopted when teaching Nepali grammar. To bring the study to completion, facts were collected and analysed from the relevant teachers, based on the areas of grammar directed by the year 6 curriculum. Thus, to advance the study, the field study method was used as the method of data collection, while the descriptive and analytical method was adopted as the method of data analysis. The study is confirmed overall by the fact that most teachers used deduction-centred activities when teaching grammar. Certain activities were more difficult than the students' academic and psychological level. Even though teachers tried to conduct these difficult activities based on classroom observation and question response, the results didn't come out as expected. To teach the basic concepts of grammar to year 6 students, it's necessary to try using appropriate activities in line with the language textbook method and language contact method, getting students to repeat activities according to their level. Although it was necessary to determine and practice activities according to the inductive method by studying the areal specificity of grammar. In fact, teachers were capable of managing and administering appropriate activities thanks to their interest and readiness towards grammar teaching.
informal_english: This article looks at what activities teachers actually use when teaching Nepali grammar. To get the full picture, I collected and analysed data from teachers based on the grammar topics the class 6 curriculum sets out. For the method, I went with field study to gather the material, and descriptive and analytical approaches to analyse it. Turns out most teachers stick to deduction-based activities when teaching grammar. Some of these activities are too hard for where the kids are at academically and psychologically. Teachers give it a go based on watching the class and seeing how students respond to questions, but it doesn't pan out like they'd hope. To teach basic grammar concepts to class 6 students, you need to use suitable activities that match the language textbook and language contact methods, getting students to do more activities at their level. Though really, they should be working out activities using the inductive method by looking at grammar's areal features. Fact is, teachers can manage and run the right activities because they're actually interested and ready to teach grammar.
translator_notes: Source is a journal article abstract from NepJOL. Sentence order preserved strictly. Devanagari names kept as-is in Nepali source; transliterated in translations. 'कक्षा ६' rendered as 'class 6' (US/AU) / 'class 6' (UK) / 'year 6' (AU) following each variety's convention. 'विद्यालय' context is primary school, so 'pupils' used in UK variant, 'students' in US/AU.
